entries.title: Counts
entries.text: Show how many builds are open and running next to each profile and on the widget.

entries.title: Full or compact
entries.text: Full shows the profile names; compact shows a short name for a small toolbar.

entries.title: On the toolbar
entries.text: Put the profile switcher on the console's top toolbar.

entries.title: On the banner
entries.text: Put the profile switcher on the banner as well.

entries.title: Profile colour
entries.text: The colour of this profile's chip in every builds table. Colours come from the theme.

entries.title: Listed
entries.text: Show this profile in the switcher's list. A profile taken off the list keeps its builds.

entries.title: Show all profiles
entries.text: Take the filter off: every builds table shows the builds of every profile.

entries.title: Manage profiles
entries.text: Create, rename or take build profiles off the list.
